label: CuteTTS compact local voice-clone adapter
summary: Use CuteTTS as a compact, optional local speech-cloning instrument for a bounded cue batch from one explicitly authorized immutable reference.

handoffs.label: Generate consent-bound compact clone cues
handoffs.intent: Render a small local speech-cue batch while preserving the source reference, exact model/code revisions, checkpoint identity, timing evidence, and review boundary.
inputs: An owned or explicitly consented local reference recording
A consent note, cue list, exact CuteTTS code/model revisions, seed, and ignored output directory
The official CuteTTS base checkpoint in an isolated ignored environment
outputs: New lossless mono WAV cues outside tracked source and release directories
A private manifest containing redacted reference location, immutable checksums, exact revisions, settings, per-cue seeds, durations, generation time, and real-time factor
Raw technical candidates that remain subject to blind listening, disclosure, rights, musical-fit, and release gates
steps: Inspect the official CuteTTS source, model revision, Apache-2.0 license, and the reference consent boundary before rendering.
Run `scripts/cutetts_voice.py` from the isolated CuteTTS environment with explicit model/code revisions, reference, consent note, seed, cue text, and a new ignored output directory.
Keep the batch small, preserve every raw candidate, and compare it blind against Qwen Base and the existing speech control at matched loudness.
Promote nothing automatically: a technical clone trial is not a performer credit, musical approval, disclosure decision, or release clearance.
verification: Confirm the reference path is withheld, the reference checksum is unchanged, checkpoints are hashed, and no destination was overwritten.
Confirm each WAV opens and matches its recorded sample rate, duration, seed, checksum, generation time, and real-time factor.
Review word accuracy, speaker identity, artifacts, dynamics, musical usefulness, consent, synthetic-media disclosure, and public-release authority as separate gates.

preserve: The immutable local reference, consent note, exact revisions, checkpoint and output hashes, settings, timing evidence, raw candidates, and listening decision
The distinction between an internal technical clone trial and an approved public vocal performance
avoid: Uploading or committing private references, cloning an unauthorized person, overwriting source audio, or presenting encoder similarity as a listening verdict
Treating an Apache-2.0 model license as blanket clearance for a voice, input, dataset, disclosure choice, or downstream release
